rig.sides: anatomical; left is on viewer's right in the rest pose
rig.coordinates: integer pixels in the shared 768x640 canvas
rig.composition: source-over by ascending z, place every layer at (0,0) in rest pose
rig.pivotApplication: rotate around each pivot in rest canvas coordinates; propagate parent transforms down the tree

core.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production art atlas for a 2D cutout-animation rig, exact identity from the attached existing game character. Repaint each piece independently with the same slightly elevated front three-quarter chibi viewpoint and detailed cel shading, ink edges, matching colors and design. Transparent alpha background, isolated opaque art, short concealed overlap stubs at the joints, no shadows, no grid lines or labels, one object per cell, 8% margins inside every cell. Anatomical left is viewer right. Keep the cells rigorously separate. Square invisible 2x2 grid. Top left: head alone from the reference in exact proportions, enormous tilted navy pointed wizard hat with crescent and stars and entire wide brim, tousled navy hair, big blue eyes, white small pointed goatee and white side whiskers, smiling and a short neck -> keep the same face. Top right: flowing dark navy cape fabric open behind body, gold narrow trim, narrow collar start, no hood. Bottom left: torso only, upright blue embroidered gold crescent-and-stars robe long front panel and gold star clasp at black belt, narrow shoulders and collar but no sleeves or arms, dark fabric overlap at shoulders. Bottom right completely empty. No staff or accessories elsewhere.
